title: All Inside Aquarium
label: Chrysalis
pull_quote: If there's one thesis song, it would be 'Literary World.' - Ben Hozie
notes: 4th album. Recorded live with producer Matt Peel in a deconsecrated church in Leeds. Hozie calls the sound 'Stone Roses-meets-Jane's Addiction'. Title track was an earlier single. 'Literary World' 7-inch (B-side 'Heart is Humming') came out Sept. 11 per Upcoming Vinyl; blog posts about the digital single are dated Sept. 10. The seed notes' single date of Sept. 16 looks wrong. Art installation at Millennium Film Workshop, Bushwick, Oct. 6-13.

title: Dopamine Chamber
label: XL Recordings
pull_quote: The album itself is a dopamine chamber... You step inside and we test these different mind- or mood-altering pieces of music on you.
notes: 5th album, produced by James Ford. Moves toward a colder, more synthetic sound. ROSALIA guests on 'Where Is Gone?', the band's first featured guest. Tracklist revealed Sept. 17. New song 'Tongue' was debuted live at Kings Theatre, Brooklyn, on Sept. 21 (preview_url is fan video of that show). Wikipedia lists 'Tongue' as a single, but no studio release date was confirmed. 'Marianne' was announced in August (Consequence, 2026/08).

title: Teen of Denial: Joe's Story (physical edition)
label: Matador
pull_quote: a freshly reimagined take on Car Seat Headrest's beloved breakout, 'Teens of Denial,' now celebrating its 10th anniversary
notes: Reimagined 10th-anniversary 'Teens of Denial'. Digital release was May 20, 2026; the physical edition follows Oct. 16. Tape Op ran a feature on Sept. 28, 2026. Studio LP 'The Scholars' came out May 2026. Label is assumed to be Matador, the band's label; the Bandcamp snippet did not state it.

title: Something for Everybody (vinyl reissue)
label: Rhino
notes: Vinyl reissue of the 2010 album, part of Rhino's Rocktober series. Mobile Fidelity also has a 45 RPM 2-LP 'Duty Now for the Future' coming, but no date was found, so it is not listed separately.

title: Peace, Love, Death Metal (vinyl reissue)
label: Rekords Rekords / Ipecac
notes: Vinyl reissue of the 2004 debut, on Josh Homme's Rekords Rekords with Ipecac. The band toured this summer for the 20th anniversary of 'Death by Sexy'. No new studio album has been announced.

title: The Kid With the Crown
label: Matador
notes: Third single from 'The Singer in My Band' (Matador), which came out Sept. 11. That is before the Sept. 18 cutoff, so the album itself is not listed. Plays The Independent, SF, on Oct. 16.
